en: Sepia-toned panoramic view of a riverside town with dense trees in the foreground, a winding river through the center, industrial chimneys and factory buildings near the water, and a compact historic town with churches and multi‑story buildings on the hills beyond. The layout and printing style are typical of early 20th‑century European picture postcards. Red handwritten numbers are visible on the top, and printed titles in German appear along the top and left margin.
